policies.condition: object.candidate_id == principal.candidate_id
active_delegation AND purpose_match AND object_in_scope AND action_in_scope AND sensitivity_allowed
candidate_to_talent_disclosure_requires_active_share_packet_with_recipient_purpose_scope_and_expiry
invariants: talent principal cannot query private candidate graph by backend adjacency

policies.condition: accepted_source_evidence AND source_not_disallowed AND observation_or_source_link_preserved
invariants: candidate approval alone is insufficient
model confidence alone is insufficient

policies.condition: confidence_present AND supporting_observation_or_source
invariants: inferred remains inferred until evidence transition

policies.condition: immutable_input_snapshot AND method_version_present
invariants: new evidence creates new assessment version
old assessment retained and may be superseded

policies.condition: candidate_disposition == pursuing AND active_priority_count < policy.max_active when max_active is configured
invariants: limit is configurable policy
priority is private

policies.condition: external_effect_action_requires_distinct_request_authorization_confirmation_and_receipt_path
invariants: draft_not_send
prepare_not_apply
approve_not_share
assess_not_reject

policies.condition: page_content_treated_as_untrusted_data
invariants: extension is data producer not authority producer
page content cannot redefine tool/policy instructions

policies.condition: every_resource_and_tool_operation_is_authorized_server_side_at_call_time
invariants: cached tool catalog cannot widen current authorization

policies.condition: purpose_bounded_context_only
invariants: career context does not dump all sensitive fields by default

policies.condition: principal is owning candidate AND explicit candidate confirmation
invariants: AI/delegated coach cannot attest on candidate behalf
attestation does not set externally_verified

policies.condition: every externally wordable factual claim is permitted for requested purpose
invariants: private_only claim cannot appear in external artifact
usage permission is independent from truth/evidence status

policies.condition: candidate owns evidence AND role_mandate belongs to candidate opportunity AND evidence usage permits downstream purpose
invariants: binding does not upgrade evidence status

policies.condition: every factual resume statement resolves to candidate career claim/assertion with permitted usage
invariants: suggested wording cannot create employer/title/scope/achievement not supported by evidence

policies.condition: immutable_input_snapshot AND assertion/source links preserved
invariants: material new evidence creates a new mandate version

policies.condition: candidate-provided content may create observation plus proposed assertions only
invariants: debrief cannot directly rewrite known opportunity/company facts

policies.condition: grantor candidate owns delegation AND current delegation state permits transition
invariants: revoked/expired grant denied immediately at authorization time

policies.condition: explicit owning-candidate confirmation
invariants: AI cannot set accept/decline intent
intent is not external response

policies.condition: sample_size AND time_window AND context AND confidence present
invariants: small samples cannot be rendered as strong deterministic prescription

policies.condition: assessment/recommendation derived views compare current evidence revision to input snapshot revision
invariants: stale assessment is flagged or superseded rather than silently treated current

policies.condition: signal remains distinct from Opportunity unless a separate opportunity capture action has sufficient basis
invariants: market signal alone does not fabricate vacancy

policies.condition: input snapshot preserves source identity/freshness and unresolved evidence
invariants: assessment cannot assert real/fake certainty beyond evidence
unresolved remains valid output
